axis0: patient right -> left (the liver lies at low axis0 in the coronal slices)
axis1: posterior -> anterior (spine at low axis1, sternum and anterior chest wall at high axis1)
axis2: superior -> inferior (great vessels leave the heart towards low axis2; liver dome and upper abdomen at high axis2)
note: Axis 2 is the SI axis, as expected from the self-navigation spoke along trajectory z, but the head is at the LOW index (the plan's template assumed high). Transverse slices (axis2 fixed) show heart, lungs, spine and descending aorta; coronal and sagittal slices show the liver above the heart in array order. The tissue fraction of transverse slices rises from 0.38 at axis2=16 to 0.84 at axis2=88 (lung -> upper abdomen). Relative to LPS only the y and z directions flip, i.e. a rotation, not a mirror.
